prompt: Edit the FIRST image. It is an animator's layout sheet: 4 posing mannequins in a 4x1 grid, the 4 successive drawings of ONE run cycle, seen from directly above (reading left to right). All 4 drawings must be the SAME character with IDENTICAL design, colours and details in every drawing: Ife, a small 14-year-old girl, the smallest of her friends (about five and a half heads tall), with dark brown skin. HAIR: black hair parted in the middle and tied up in two big round afro puffs, one on each side of the top of her head. JUMPER: an oversized plain pale-green knitted jumper with a thick rolled turtle neck, ribbed hem and cuffs, and baggy sleeves that come down to her knuckles. SHORTS AND LEGGINGS: short plain grey shorts with a turned-up hem over plain dark navy leggings. SHOES: plain dark-grey canvas trainers with grey laces and grey soles. FACE: big round dark eyes, small worried eyebrows, a small mouth. No pins, no badges, no emblems, no insignia, no stars, no lettering, no numbers, no logos and no brand marks anywhere on her. Style as the second image: 1990s cel anime: bold clean black ink outlines of even weight, flat colour fills, two tones per material (a base and one hard-edged shade), no gradients, no texture, no soft shading, no motion blur, no speed lines, no ground, no shadows on the ground, no text, no panel borders. Background: one flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, also between the legs and inside every gap. Every part of every mannequin is painted over: her hands are dark-brown skin, her legs are navy leggings, her shoes dark grey. Nothing blue or red may remain anywhere.
